n5611838826.headline: Samsung's quarterly profit falls 56% compared to 2018
n5611838826.summary: Samsung reported a 56% drop in quarterly profit compared to 2018, impacted by falling chip sales and the US ban on Huawei.
n5611838826.why: Samsung is a leading global technology and semiconductor company; its earnings reflect trends in chip demand and geopolitical trade tensions affecting the tech sector.
